“The Red Umbrella” passes silently through your mind—a possibility, nothing more—then you return to the page.

Below, the auditorium doors open. There is a careful sequence of knocks and muted scrapes as the programme boards are carried back out, followed by Rosa’s voice saying something too low to catch. A few minutes later, the foyer quiets again: a door closes, footsteps cross the landing, and the building resumes its evening creaks around you.
